profile.headline: C++ Senior Software Engineer at Kratos Defense and Security Solutions
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer specializing in C++ and Java on multiple platforms.

Specialties: I have experience in Missile Defense Wargamming, Warehousing, Integrated Circuit (FAB work) construction, data storage solutions, casino video game development, and, lately, automated ocean going vessel development.
